title: EVGA Precision X1 Crashes on Launch
shortDescription: OC utility closes immediately or hangs.
fullDescription: Precision X1 conflicts with MSI Afterburner and ASUS GPU Tweak. Uninstall conflicting tools and reinstall .NET 4.8.

faq.a: Optional; Nvidia App now does basic OC.

title: EVGA iCX2 Fan Stops Mid-Game
fullDescription: iCX2 fan stop is normal under low temp; mid-game stop indicates fan failure or pinched cable.

fixSteps.title: RMA / step-up
fixSteps.instruction: EVGA warranty was famous; submit if still under coverage.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Order EVGA replacement fan, swap on shroud.

faq.a: EVGA exited GPU market in 2022; warranty honored on existing cards.

title: RTX 3090 Ti EVGA 12VHPWR Adapter Melt
fullDescription: Inadequate seating of 12VHPWR / 12V-2x6 adapters has caused melting. Stop using card immediately and contact EVGA / Nvidia.

fixSteps.title: Stop using
fixSteps.instruction: Power off immediately. Do not reuse adapter.

fixSteps.title: RMA / Nvidia replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Submit through EVGA or Nvidia recall channel.

faq.a: Sometimes cable only; sometimes solder pads damaged.

title: Driver Timeout on EVGA Card
fullDescription: Caused by unstable OC, bad driver, or PSU sag. Reset to stock and DDU.

fixSteps.title: DDU clean install
fixSteps.instruction: Safe Mode > DDU > latest Nvidia driver.

faq.a: Old PSUs can sag under transient loads.

title: EVGA RGB Backplate Stops Lighting
shortDescription: RGB on backplate randomly turns off.
fullDescription: Often a controller PCB issue. RMA still possible during EVGA warranty window.

title: Hotspot Delta vs GPU Core Too Wide
fullDescription: Wide delta indicates poor heatsink mount or pump-out of thermal paste. Repaste with quality compound.

fixSteps.title: Repaste
fixSteps.instruction: Replace thermal paste with PTM7950 or Kryonaut.

faq.a: EVGA was known to honor anyway; verify with support.

title: Coil Whine on EVGA Card
shortDescription: Buzz from inductors at high FPS.
fullDescription: Cap framerate; severe cases may RMA.

fixSteps.title: Cap FPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use Nvidia control panel max frame rate.

faq.a: Yes, modern GPUs all whine to varying degree.

title: GPU VBIOS Update Failed
shortDescription: nvflash update aborted leaving card unstable.
fullDescription: Recover by booting on iGPU and reflashing using -6 force flag with backup VBIOS.

fixSteps.title: Reflash with nvflash -6
fixSteps.instruction: Force flash original VBIOS via DOS USB.

title: BSOD When Loading Heavy Game
fullDescription: Common with marginal PSU during transient spikes. Use higher-watt PSU.

fixSteps.title: Update driver
fixSteps.instruction: Latest Nvidia driver via Nvidia App.

faq.a: Yes, drop PL to 80% as workaround.

title: Kingpin / Hybrid AIO Pump Whine
fullDescription: Reorient pump above radiator and bleed air. EVGA Hybrid kits are sealed.

fixSteps.title: Tilt case
fixSteps.instruction: Tilt PC to bleed air toward radiator.

fixSteps.title: Mount radiator higher
fixSteps.instruction: Top mount above pump for better flow.

faq.a: Some EVGA AIOs have fill ports; verify before opening.
